description: SDEM's starting pattern for any BIAN service domain whose functional pattern is Fulfill — it fulfils the obligations of a service arrangement over its life. What such a domain has in each layer of a complete design: who uses it, what carries it, where its arrangement is kept and where it runs. It applies by the domain's functional pattern, so one file covers every Fulfill domain; a pattern for a particular kind of solution (payment initiation) says more. Shipped with SDEM; a person includes it (sdem profile include sdem:sdem-pattern-bian-fulfill.json). Every part is a warning — to decide, never a failed check.

pattern.title: BIAN Fulfill — a arrangement
pattern.source: BIAN Semantic API Practitioner Guide v8.1 §3.2.1, Figure 9 (the functional patterns and their generic artefacts: Fulfill — Arrangement); BIAN Service Landscape 14.0; ArchiMate 3.2; docs/design/sdem-completeness-design.md (CPL-12)

roles.label: Business capability the domain supports
roles.reasoning: a service domain is there for a business capability; without one the design does not say what it is for

roles.label: Process that uses the domain
roles.reasoning: the business step in which the arrangement is handled

roles.label: Business service the process provides
roles.reasoning: an arrangement is a service the organisation gives a customer over time

roles.label: Product the arrangements are for
roles.reasoning: BIAN: a Fulfill domain fulfils the obligations of a service arrangement, most often for a product or facility

roles.label: The domain's service groups (BIAN)
roles.reasoning: BIAN groups what the domain offers; its operations are reached through them

roles.label: The domain's service operations (BIAN)
roles.reasoning: what BIAN says can be done with the arrangement

roles.label: API operation that implements one of the domain's operations
roles.reasoning: a domain no API implements is offered to nothing

roles.label: Component that realises the domain
roles.reasoning: software carries the domain; without it nothing does

roles.label: Record of the arrangement
roles.reasoning: the arrangement is the domain's control record in BIAN — the design keeps it somewhere

roles.label: Platform the record is stored on
roles.reasoning: a record is durable only on a platform

roles.label: Deployment of the component
roles.reasoning: software that is deployed nowhere runs nowhere
